bio.fr: Ancien guérillero des Tupamaros, il passe environ treize ans en prison, en grande partie à l'isolement, sous la dictature militaire. Président de l'Uruguay de 2010 à 2015, il fait légaliser le cannabis et le mariage entre personnes de même sexe. Son mode de vie austère et le don de l'essentiel de son salaire lui valent une notoriété mondiale.
bio.en: A former Tupamaros guerrilla, he spent around thirteen years in prison under the military dictatorship, much of it in solitary confinement. As president of Uruguay from 2010 to 2015, he oversaw the legalisation of cannabis and of same-sex marriage. His frugal lifestyle and his habit of giving away most of his salary made him known worldwide.
